title: rosa graveolens var. micrantha
intro: Rosa graveolens var. micrantha, commonly known as Dwarf Rosa or Rosa Dwarf, is a variety of the Rosa graveolens plant, a type of rose species. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa graveolens var. micrantha include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality, as well as its use in treating skin conditions and wounds due to its antiseptic and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
